releaseControls.boundary: The static verifier binds the current browser document, stylesheet, application script, and architecture SVG to the reviewed rights manifest and returns STATIC_SOURCE_PASS. The dependency-free browser verifier then runs those bytes in an isolated local headless Chromium profile, rejects unexpected browser or network errors, inspects the rendered accessibility tree, exercises skip and presenter keyboard paths, and emulates reduced motion plus a 390-pixel mobile viewport before returning LOCAL_BROWSER_PASS. Both receipts remain finalReleaseReady false. They are not a WCAG conformance claim, maintained rules-engine scan, assistive-technology test, human review, or proof of deployed bytes.
remainingRequirements: Bind a maintained rules-engine scan plus keyboard-only, 200% zoom, mobile reflow, reduced-motion, and screen-reader private review to the exact public release and deployed bytes.

releaseControls.boundary: Only the exact V09 architecture SVG and PNG are rights-cleared for the listed public channels; no other production visual is cleared by this control.
